cartographic_sources.notes: Surveyed main pavement and buildings; civil aprons, K/Z connectors and Monaco traced from orthophoto/SIA. Runway dimensions 1399 x 30 m / 799 x 30 m. 09/27 coordinates span 792 m: nominal 799 m strip centred on the published axis. Cartographic runway paint, not a surveyed marking inventory. No yellow guidance lines; no invented stand numbers.
